sentences.text: Complete genome sequences were reported for Sellimonas intestinalis type strain JCM 30749 and three related Sellimonas genomes, each a single circular chromosome of about 2.8 to 3.8 million base pairs.
In 752 participants with type 2 diabetes, a study identified Sellimonas intestinalis as one of three gut species associated with albuminuria.
In Malian children, a study reported that those susceptible to febrile malaria had a greater abundance of several bacteria including Sellimonas intestinalis.
